messages:
Alex Rivera: Quick UX question about the small clipboard icon in Console -> Logs. Current hover shows `Copy`. Should we hint the keyboard shortcut too (e.g. `Cmd/Ctrl + C`) or keep the tooltip minimal?
Marta Chen: I'm fine with a minimal tooltip. Long tooltips get noisy. My preference: keep tooltip as `Copy` and show the shortcut only on focus or in a subtle inline helper.
Kevin O'Neill: A11y reminder: not all screen readers will read tooltips. Make sure the button itself has a clear aria-label like `Copy log line to clipboard` so assistive tech and keyboard users get the full context.
design-bot: Screenshot of current state attached in thread.
Alex Rivera: Proposed approach: 1) visual tooltip text = `Copy` 2) on hover OR keyboard focus, show a small secondary helper `Cmd/Ctrl + C` (visually lighter) 3) add aria-label `Copy log line to clipboard` to the button 4) ensure helper is reachable via keyboard focus and not solely hover-triggered. Thoughts?
Marta Chen: Sounds good. For the helper text, localization prefers `Cmd/Ctrl + C` spelled out rather than symbols so translators don't miss it. Keep helper copy short and without extra punctuation.
Kevin O'Neill: Agreed. Also add a tiny visual indicator when the copy action succeeds (e.g., checkmark toast) so users know the action worked; its accessibility label should be `Copied to clipboard` and it should be announced by SR.
Alex Rivera: Good call on confirmation. I'll update the spec: tooltip = `Copy`, helper = `Cmd/Ctrl + C` on hover or focus, aria-label = `Copy log line to clipboard`, success toast = `Copied to clipboard` (announce).
Marta Chen: Figma nit: current component uses an em dash between shortcut and label. Switch to a separate helper element in the component so translators don't have to parse punctuation.
Kevin O'Neill: Quick dev checklist: update i18n keys `console.logs.copy_button.label` and `console.logs.copy_button.aria`, add UI test for keyboard focus helper, and add an a11y test confirming SR announcement on copy.
Alex Rivera: I'll PR the Figma change and open a small frontend PR with tests. Tagging you both once ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Marta Chen: Thanks — will review the Figma update.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll review the frontend PR tomorrow morning.
